title: Practice: order a request for cache hits (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 stable content comes first and the volatile date goes last
cases.says: Stable content comes first, the volatile date goes last, and the breakpoints sit on the stable blocks

cases.id: e1 sections follow the prefix order and keep their own order
cases.says: Sections follow the prefix order and keep their own order

cases.id: e2 a breakpoint needs the stable prefix to reach the minimum
cases.says: A breakpoint needs the stable prefix up to it to reach the minimum

cases.id: e3 at most four breakpoints are sent
cases.says: At most four breakpoints are sent, counting only those that reach the minimum

cases.id: e4 a one hour breakpoint may not follow a five minute one
cases.says: A one-hour breakpoint may not follow a five-minute one

cases.id: e5 volatile blocks never carry a breakpoint and tools cannot be volatile
cases.says: A volatile block never carries a breakpoint, and tools cannot be volatile

cases.id: e6 every block comes out once and the input is not changed
cases.says: Every block comes out once and the input is not changed
